import sys

# Read all input as tokens for fast I/O
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
it = iter(data)

n = int(next(it))
if n > 11:
    print(0)
    sys.exit(0)

coord = [[0]*5 for _ in range(n)]
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(5):
        coord[i][j] = int(next(it))

# vect[i][j] is vector from point i to point j
vect = [[[0]*5 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        for k in range(5):
            vect[i][j][k] = coord[j][k] - coord[i][k]

bad = [False]*n
count = n

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if j != i:
            for k in range(n):
                if k != j and k != i:
                    prod = 0
                    for m in range(5):
                        prod += vect[j][i][m] * vect[k][i][m]
                    if prod > 0 and not bad[i]:
                        bad[i] = True
                        count -= 1

print(count)
for i in range(n):
    if not bad[i]:
        print(i+1)
